geometry_investigation.question: Quantify geometry freshness/retention and association with unknown states and numeric failures, comparing timer-only full16 with safe full13.
geometry_investigation.scope: Read-only artifact/code inspection; no source changes, candidate runs, or tests.

fresh_frame_location.basis: Inferred from current production control flow and aggregate telemetry, not stored as a per-frame telemetry field: the initial calibration is made from frames[0], loop index 0 uses it, anchor redetection begins only for index > 0, every frame is effectively calibrated, and there is exactly one fresh calibration success.

reset_transition_count.basis: Inferred: all post-initial fresh results are insufficient_anchors; the analyzer retains the previous calibration for this reason and replaces it only on fresh success or a geometry-invalid reason. No explicit reset counter exists.

comparison.reset_evidence: All failed fresh checks are insufficient_anchors. Production analyzer preserves the previous calibration for that reason; the sole fresh success is the initial frames[0] calibration. This implies zero later calibration replacements in these runs, though no explicit reset counter/timestamp is exported.

timer_comparison.interpretation: Observed timer availability differs while geometry telemetry and anchor assets remain essentially unchanged. This is correlation, not a causal claim.

retained_calibration_start_full16.basis: first frame after the inferred initial fresh calibration

production_code_evidence.claim: Configured anchor thresholds gate accepted normalized boxes; score stats track each attempt.
Calibration uses a minimum of three anchors and position/size tolerances.
First frame establishes initial calibration; same-resolution geometry is then checked per frame.
Only insufficient_anchors preserves prior calibration; success or any different reason replaces it.
Numeric reads run when effective calibration is true; state classification runs separately.
Player-specific HP/armor/ammo/weapon/ability values are cleared unless state is player-specific.
Live identity needs geometry, verified spectator absence, three structural signals and no competing view.
Telemetry records aggregate fresh/effective outcomes and anchor scores, without a frame-indexed timeline.

limitations: Per-frame anchor detection/accepted scores and reset timestamps are not exported. Initial fresh-calibration frame and absence of later replacement are inferred from current analyzer control flow plus aggregate telemetry; these are not explicit telemetry fields.
Anchor accept/reject counts are aggregate; they cannot be joined to specific unknown-state segments.
Runs use identical video, pack and assertions, but different settings and dirty-code fingerprints. Do not interpret differences causally.
A missing evaluator snapshot records missing output in its tolerance window; nearest raw state is correlation only.

summary.round_start_end_zero_cause: The direct HUD event detector ran, but the observations around the annotated boundaries did not meet its state-transition, timer, banner, score, corroboration, and confidence conditions. Only one fallback partial RoundPackage was built, so all trace rows were assigned sample_round_1 and no sample_round_2 exists.
summary.visual_event_zero_cause: Visual analysis ran. Its 14 emitted candidates were all shot candidates suppressed below the candidate threshold; no candidate was projected as a confirmed visual event. At the annotated three-shot window, muzzle scores stayed below the trace adapter's 0.5 observation threshold and player-mechanics eligibility was false.
summary.map_resolution_zero_cause: Zone-resolution ran for every frame but returned no map or zone. The E2E invocation supplied no visual profile, manual map id, or map build. The runner therefore constructed an empty visual profile (then added only a minimap ROI); automatic selection failed on all 455 HUD-eligible frames, while map calibration was skipped on the other 4206 frames because player-mechanics HUD eligibility was false.
summary.implementation_status: These producers and consumers are implemented and invoked in the run. The zeros describe unavailable or rejected runtime evidence/configuration, not missing feature code.
summary.scope_classification: The first widest package-label blocker is 29 failed assertions: all 25 failed assertions labelled sample_round_2, plus the four early sample_round_1 snapshot/zone assertions at 3.5 and 4.15 seconds. The four additional round-boundary assertions are the GT-R1 start/end required-point checks and the sample_round_1 start/end count constraints. This 29+4=33 set identifies a plausible first blocking scope, not 33 assured passes and not an exhaustive count of every downstream failure.

visual_input_guards.guard_rule: Visual mechanics are eligible only for primary_state=live_first_person, player_specific_hud_valid=true, and no visual-transition/buy-phase/round-end blocking flags.

annotated_muzzle_window_evidence.consequence: No sample in the three expected tolerance windows reaches the trace muzzle threshold; even a qualifying score would receive actor=unknown while player_mechanics is false.

timer_display.reason: The HUD binding stores timer readings only as round_time_remaining_sec. The trace adapter intentionally emits game_timer_display only from round_time_remaining_display and does not reconstruct display text from seconds.

first_blocking_scope.qualification: This is a first-blocking dependency scope, not a promise of 33 passes and not the total set of failures.

theoretical_pass_requirements_without_pr.round_point_events: Produce real native events with the required type, actor, round label and acceptance-window time. For death, the event must also carry victim_name, killer_agent and combat_report_damage_received exactly as required_event_attributes. The evaluator separately checks the event_count_constraints. R2 assertions require a second corresponding native RoundPackage so the trace adapter can assign sample_round_2.
theoretical_pass_requirements_without_pr.round_start_evidence: Current detector path requires a prior buy_menu_open or buy_phase_banner state, a transition to live_first_person without the buy flag, a round timer increase greater than 3 seconds, and confidence at least 0.65 for both observations.
theoretical_pass_requirements_without_pr.round_end_evidence: Current detector path requires round_end_banner context plus a corroborating score change or timer stop/disappearance, then event confidence at least 0.65. A score-joined banner also needs joined evidence and confidence.
theoretical_pass_requirements_without_pr.death_evidence: Current detector path requires combat_report_visible plus an independent transition/identity/death cue (spectator_transition, self_hud_identity_lost, or roster_self_dead); event output must then satisfy pack-required identity/damage attributes for a required-point match.
theoretical_pass_requirements_without_pr.visual_shot_and_muzzle: For the shot count constraint, at least one to at most three confirmed player shot events must land in [73.9, 74.39] under sample_round_1. For the three muzzle assertions, each trace visual observation must be muzzle_flash by actor player in sample_round_1 within 0.08 seconds of its expected time. The observations require player_mechanics eligibility; an unknown actor does not match.
theoretical_pass_requirements_without_pr.map_zone: Return validated zone_id values matching summit_a_approach at the two R1 asserted snapshots and summit_attacker_spawn at the R2 asserted snapshot, with corresponding trace snapshots at the specified time tolerances. Map selection/calibration must succeed on real eligible frames; no zone should be inferred from the ground truth.
theoretical_pass_requirements_without_pr.expanded_map: Produce a sample_round_2 expanded_tactical_map primary-state interval covering at least 70 percent of core interval [149.0,150.5] and respecting the exhaustive outer interval [148.8,150.8].
